events.summary: Speaker A set the goal: an original, trendy and user-friendly remote to beat competitors.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: to have an advantage over our competitors we have to be original, we have to be trendy

events.summary: Speaker A set the production cost target as lower than twelve point five Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: to have a production cost lower than twelve point five Euros

events.summary: Speaker A set the selling price at twice the production cost.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: have a selling price of twice that price

events.summary: Speaker A set the profit target at fifty million Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: in order to target a profe profit of uh fifty uh million Euros

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a single-device remote if bundled with a product, otherwise a programmable multi-device remote.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: then it could be a single device, otherwise it could be programmable one

events.summary: Speaker A decided the remote should control multiple devices, since it is sold on its own.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: So maybe it should be for multiple devices

events.summary: Speaker C proposed fewer buttons.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: If we don't have so many buttons could be nice

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a backlit remote so it can be used in the dark.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: to be lighted in order to be used in the dark

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a shape that is not squarey and not a box.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: Something which is not squarey maybe uh, not a box

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a shape that fits in the hand, as the basic requirement.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: Something like that, least fits in your hand

events.summary: Speaker A proposed making the remote resist shocks from falls.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: to resist to various shocks that can happen if it fall

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a waterproof remote that can be used in the bath, as an original feature.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Havin having a water-proof remote control so that the people can uh use it in their bath

events.summary: Speaker B objected to built-in waterproofing, saying a user can cover the remote with plastic instead.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you can just cover it with some plastic

events.summary: Speaker A objected that a plastic cover is still something the user has to buy.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it is still something uh you have to buy

events.summary: Speaker A proposed bundling a plastic protective cover with the waterproofing.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: But maybe we can bulk it with uh already this plastic thing and uh the waterproof uh stuff as well

events.summary: Speaker B objected that the bundled cover would look bulky.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it will look a bulky in that case

events.summary: Speaker A proposed selling the plastic protection and a waterproof box together, either optional or bundled.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Maybe we can sell uh all that together, so so plastic protection

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a special button on the TV that makes the remote beep.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: We should have s uh special bu button on the T_V_ to make the remote control beeping

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a remote that beeps when the user whistles.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Maybe we can have uh something you whistle and uh the remote control uh beep

events.summary: Speaker A decided on a whistle-tracking remote, which is original and gives an advantage.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Whistle tracking remote control. That's a good idea, that's very original

events.summary: Speaker B objected that audio recording for whistle tracking is not normally needed and would add to the cost.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: So i it's just going to add t to the cost

events.summary: Speaker A asked Speaker B to find out who sets the budget, for the next meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Okay so try to find that for next meeting

events.summary: Speaker A asked the Industrial Designer, Speaker B, to find out more about industrial design for the working function.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I will ask the Industrial Designer to find out more about this industrial design
